case_title.quote: GURPAL SINGH v. STATE OF PUNJAB

number_of_accused.quote: acquitting the co-accused Harpartap Singh, his son
number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided by the Supreme Court; the co-accused was already acquitted.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant... rushed downstairs of his house and brought his DBBL gun
accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as male and has a son.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation is stated; the mention of fields is not an occupation.

victim_gender.quote: hit Paramjit and Jatinder on their abdomen and Lakhwinder on his mouth and head
victim_gender.reason: Victims include both men and a woman.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: lingering land dispute between the informant and the appellant, who are brothers
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The brother relationship and land dispute are stated; the other victims are friends of the informant's son.

offence_category.quote: conviction of the appellant ought to be moderated to one under Section 304 Part 1 IPC and 307 IPC
offence_category.reason: The charge was murder, but the final established offence is culpable homicide (plus attempt to murder).

statutory_provisions.quote: charge-sheet was laid against both the accused persons under Sections 302 and 307 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Charged and final sections are correctly given.

weapon.quote: the 12 bore DBBL gun loaded with two live cartridges used for the offence

evidence_type.quote: The medical evidence reveals injuries on the deceased and the injured compatible with the weapon used.
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery and site plan evidence are all noted.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: fired from his gun towards them, which hit Paramjit and Jatinder
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Firing at several persons, causing one death and injuries, is supported by the facts.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: overpowered by an uncontrollable fit of anger... twelve years have elapsed

trial_court_outcome.quote: life imprisonment and fine of Rs.5,000/- ... five years rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.2,000/-
trial_court_outcome.reason: Accurate; sentences concurrent and co-accused acquitted.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court has affirmed the conviction and the sentence recorded by the Trial Court

final_outcome.quote: the appeal is partly allowed. The conviction of the appellant is converted
final_outcome.reason: Conviction was altered and the sentence reduced.

offence_finally_established.quote: converted to one under Section 304 Part I and 307 IPC

imprisonment_type.quote: the sentence is reduced to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: The sentence was reduced to the period already undergone, a fixed term rather than 'not stated'.

imprisonment_years.quote: the sentence is reduced to the period already undergone
imprisonment_years.reason: The number of years is not stated, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove gendered pronouns for the accused (e.g. 'his own son', 'his son'), using 'the accused's son' instead.
neutral_facts.quote: The accused came with his own son.
neutral_facts.reason: The facts are accurate and outcome-free, but 'his' gives the accused's gender, which the instructions prohibit.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state statutory punishment ranges.

attempt_completion.quote: Jatinder succumbed to the injuries sustained
attempt_completion.reason: A death occurred, so the main offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: hit the informant on the side of his head ... Jatinder succumbed
physical_harm.reason: Injuries and death are accurately described.

number_of_offences.quote: conviction of the appellant ought to be moderated to one under Section 304 Part 1 IPC and 307 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged; two convictions stand.

premeditation_planning.quote: overpowered by an uncontrollable fit of anger
premeditation_planning.reason: The court found sudden anger, not planning.

motive.quote: over a lingering land dispute ... the appellant had hurled abuses to him

key_evidence_accepted.quote: gun ... had been recovered from the appellant... four cartridge shells have also been recovered

post_offence_conduct.quote: the appellant and the accused fled the scene
post_offence_conduct.reason: Fleeing is noted as part of the prosecution account.

trial_duration.quote: on 06.07.2002 ... the occurrence is of the year 2004
trial_duration.reason: Dates are accurately given and the discrepancy is noted.

legal_representation.quote: Yatinder Singh, Sr. Adv.( AC), Arijeet Singh, Ms. Aprajita Anvita

investigation_status.quote: After completing the investigation, charge-sheet was laid

appeal_history.reason: Outcomes at each level are accurate.

prosecution_argument.quote: telltale testimony of the injured eye-witnesses, supported on all fours by the medical evidence

defence_argument.quote: exoneration of the co-accused ... all the purported eye-witnesses are relatives

legal_principle_applied.quote: had the knowledge of the likely fatal consequences thereof

sentencing_rationale.quote: it would meet the ends of justice, if the sentence for the offences is reduced

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: twelve years have elapsed ... uncontrollable fit of anger

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court weighed no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: the appellant is hereby ordered to be set at liberty forthwith
